subject: Life Skills
title: Tone of Voice Signals
description: A 60-second lesson on Tone of Voice Signals.

hook.text: Albert Mehrabian's study found that when words and tone conflict, people believe the tone 85% of the time.

buildup.text: Pitch rises when people are nervous or lying. It drops when they feel confident or dominant.

discovery.text: Speed matters too. Rushing through a topic often signals discomfort. Slowing down signals care or emphasis.

twist.text: Some cultures naturally speak louder or faster. Without knowing the baseline, you will misread volume as aggression.

climax.text: Listen for mismatches: cheerful words in a flat tone, agreement in a tight voice. The mismatch is the real message.

punchline.text: When words say yes but tone says no, trust the tone.

quiz.question: What does a mismatch between words and tone usually indicate?
options: The tone reflects the true feeling more than the words
They are confused about what they want to say
